-- DISTINCT作用： 避免多分类、多标签文章重复出现 SELECT DISTINCT -- 文章基本信息 p.id AS post_id, p.title AS post_title, p.slug AS post_slug, p.excerpt AS post_excerpt, p.cover_image_url AS post_cover_image_url, p.view_count AS post_view_count, p.like_count AS post_like_count, p.comment_count AS post_comment_count, p.share_count AS post_share_count, p.reading_time AS post_reading_time, p.is_featured AS post_is_featured, p.is_top AS post_is_top, p.published_at AS post_published_at,
-- 作者信息 u.id AS author_id, u.username AS author_username, up.display_name AS author_display_name, up.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url, up.bio AS author_bio,
-- 分类信息 c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name, c.slug AS category_slug, c.description AS category_description,
-- 标签信息 t.id AS tag_id, t.name AS tag_name, t.slug AS tag_slug, t.color AS tag_color FROM posts p
-- 关联作者信息 LEFT JOIN "user" u ON p.author_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON u.id = up.user_id
-- 关联分类信息 LEFT JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
-- 关联标签信息 LEFT JOIN post_tags pt ON p.id = pt.post_id LEFT JOIN tags t ON pt.tag_id = t.id
-- 只获取已发布、允许公开访问且作者为活跃状态的文章 WHERE p.status = 'published' AND p.visibility = 'public' AND u.status = 'active'
-- 动态查询条件 -- 关键字搜索
AND (p.title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.q}, '%') OR p.excerpt ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.q}, '%') OR p.content ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.q}, '%') OR u.username ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.q}, '%') OR up.display_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.q}, '%'))
-- 分类ID过滤
AND p.category_id = #{params.categoryId}
-- 分类名称过滤
AND c.name = #{params.categoryName}
-- 标签ID过滤
AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM post_tags pt2 WHERE pt2.post_id = p.id AND pt2.tag_id = #{params.tagId} )
-- 标签名称过滤
AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM post_tags pt2 JOIN tags t2 ON pt2.tag_id = t2.id WHERE pt2.post_id = p.id AND t2.name = #{params.tagName} )
-- 作者ID过滤
AND p.author_id = #{params.authorId}
-- 作者用户名过滤
AND u.username = #{params.authorUsername}
-- 作者显示名称过滤
AND up.display_name = #{params.authorDisplayName}
-- 是否置顶过滤
AND p.is_top = #{params.isTop}
-- 是否精选过滤
AND p.is_featured = #{params.isFeatured}
-- 发布时间范围过滤
AND p.published_at >= #{params.pageable.startTime}
AND p.published_at <= #{params.pageable.endTime}
-- 动态排序 ORDER BY
p.created_at DESC
p.created_at ASC
p.published_at DESC
p.published_at ASC
p.title DESC
p.title ASC
p.view_count DESC
p.view_count ASC
p.like_count DESC
p.like_count ASC
-- 默认按发布时间降序排序 p.published_at DESC

SELECT -- 文章基本信息 p.id AS post_id, p.title AS post_title, p.slug AS post_slug,
p.excerpt AS post_excerpt, p.html_content AS post_html_content, p.reading_time AS post_reading_time,
p.cover_image_url AS post_cover_image_url, p.featured_image_url AS post_featured_image_url, p.is_featured AS post_is_featured, p.is_top AS post_is_top,
p.view_count AS post_view_count, p.like_count AS post_like_count, p.comment_count AS post_comment_count, p.share_count AS post_share_count,
p.seo_title AS post_seo_title, p.seo_description AS post_seo_description, p.seo_keywords AS post_seo_keywords,
p.published_at AS post_published_at, p.last_modified_at AS post_last_modified_at,
p.allow_comments AS post_allow_comments,
-- 版本历史 r.id AS revision_id, r.title AS revision_title, r.version AS revision_version, r.summary AS revision_summary, r.created_at AS revision_created_at,
-- 作者信息 u.id AS author_id, u.username AS author_username, up.display_name AS author_display_name, up.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url, up.bio AS author_bio,
-- 分类信息 c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name, c.slug AS category_slug, c.description AS category_description,
-- 标签信息 t.id AS tag_id, t.name AS tag_name, t.slug AS tag_slug, t.color AS tag_color
FROM posts p
-- 关联最新的版本信息 LEFT JOIN post_revisions r ON p.id = r.post_id AND r.version = ( SELECT MAX(version) FROM post_revisions WHERE post_id = p.id )
-- 关联作者信息 LEFT JOIN "user" u ON p.author_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON u.id = up.user_id
-- 关联分类信息 LEFT JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
-- 关联标签信息 LEFT JOIN post_tags pt ON p.id = pt.post_id LEFT JOIN tags t ON pt.tag_id = t.id
mapper.select: -- 只获取指定ID且已发布、允许公开访问且作者为活跃状态的文章 WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.status = 'published' AND p.visibility = 'public' AND u.status = 'active'
-- 只获取指定slug且已发布、允许公开访问且作者为活跃状态的文章 WHERE p.slug = #{slug} AND p.status = 'published' AND p.visibility = 'public' AND u.status = 'active'

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.slug FROM posts p LEFT JOIN "user" u ON p.author_id = u.id WHERE p.status = 'published' AND p.visibility = 'public' AND u.status = 'active' AND p.id != #{currentPostId} AND p.published_at < #{publishedAt} ORDER BY p.published_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.slug FROM posts p LEFT JOIN "user" u ON p.author_id = u.id WHERE p.status = 'published' AND p.visibility = 'public' AND u.status = 'active' AND p.id != #{currentPostId} AND p.published_at > #{publishedAt} ORDER BY p.published_at LIMIT 1
SELECT meta_key AS "key", meta_value AS "value" FROM post_meta WHERE post_id = #{postId}

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.slug, p.cover_image_url AS coverImageUrl FROM posts p LEFT JOIN "user" u ON p.author_id = u.id WHERE p.status = 'published' AND p.visibility = 'public' AND u.status = 'active' AND p.id != #{currentPostId} ORDER BY -- 综合热度排序：浏览量 * 0.4 + 点赞数 * 0.3 + 评论数 * 0.2 + 分享数 * 0.1 (p.view_count * 0.4 + p.like_count * 0.3 + p.comment_count * 0.2 + p.share_count * 0.1) DESC, p.published_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
